About this product

It is equipped with a dual-core IPQ-5010 ARM CPU operating at 800 MHz, 256 MB of RAM, and 128 MB of NAND flash storage, running RouterOS v7 with a Level 4 licence. This device operates on dual-band 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n/ax wireless standards, achieving a maximum data rate of 574 Mbps with a 4.3 dBi antenna gain.
